title: Report covers — MS Word template
slide_intent: Identify which parts of a report cover a local editor can change while keeping title and program credit easy to find.
strategic_value: The shared Word template can give reports from different programs a family resemblance even when their photographs and headings differ.
demonstration: Two covers place a photograph above a curved title field, white on one and red on the other. Both retain a web address near the top and the mark at the foot.
practical_value: Replace the header image and local address, then fill the footer with the accredited program name. Use the specified 42 pt Ubuntu Light heading and 10.5 pt Ubuntu Bold subtitle.

content_islands.name: Template instructions
content_islands.spec: Number the notes on the left for editable items, color variants and type settings.

content_islands.name: Two cover treatments
content_islands.spec: Align the two covers. Show the title block below the curved photo boundary and keep the program identifier at lower right. Key the numbered markers to the notes.
